verdict.rationale: Typesense's open-source, self-hosted nature and documented 'Running Tests with Testcontainers'/GitHub Actions guidance let a developer spin up an isolated local instance (confirmed via a runtime probe that booted a local server with a self-set API key, no account, no cloud) and test typo-tolerant search independent of any production cluster. However, there's no first-party 'sandbox environment' or dedicated non-production tier called out (Typesense Cloud pricing/docs focus on production dedicated clusters, not an explicit sandbox mode). Missing for 10: an explicit hosted sandbox/staging environment offering, and documentation contrasting sandbox vs production data isolation guarantees.
